hero.intro: I work on AI agents and evaluation at Qwen, with experience in creator platforms and hands-on product development. Currently studying Social Anthropology at LSE.

education.school: London School of Economics and Political Science
education.courses: **Coursework:** Psychological Anthropology (Distinction), Anthropology of Religion (Distinction), Digital Anthropology, Gender and Kinship, Anthropological Research Methods.
**Coursework:** Global Communication, Data Visualization, Introduction to Statistics, Digital Media Marketing Strategy, Journalism Ethics and Media Regulation, Cross-cultural Multimedia News Editing.

experience.intro: Worked on video-creation agents, Skill evaluation, creator onboarding, and early-stage overseas growth.

projects.title: Qwen Create [[Agent Teams|A group of coordinated AI agents working across the steps of video creation.]]
projects.subtitle: A [[multi-agent system|A system where multiple specialized AI agents coordinate to complete a larger task.]] for end-to-end video creation
projects.intro: Built and evaluated reusable Skills for short-form storytelling and commerce videos, while improving workflow reliability and supporting new generation models.

bullets.label: Skill evaluation system
bullets.body: Built layered test sets, evaluation criteria, and an automated execution platform to make manual Skill reviews more consistent and efficient. Generated [[Skill-specific instructions|Test tasks are tailored to each Skill’s intended capability and use case, including short-form drama and commerce content.]]; compared no-Skill baselines and Skill versions under fixed model and tool conditions. Evaluated individual steps and complete task outcomes, then used tool-call traces to locate failures. The internally launched platform covers [[100+ Skills|Evaluation coverage: more than 100 Skills and their versions. This is separate from the number supplied through the creation workflow.]].

bullets.label: Skill creation & author onboarding
bullets.body: Helped launch an agent that turns canvas nodes, connections, inputs, outputs, and parameters into editable Skill drafts. Used multimodal understanding to break down shot structure, source assets, and creative choices, supporting [[50+ reusable Skills|Reusable Skills supplied through the creation work, distinct from evaluation coverage.]]. Prepared creator guidance, submission standards, and reference packs to help external authors turn their expertise into reusable Skills.

bullets.label: Short-form storytelling workflows
bullets.body: Built a specialized Agent Team from creator needs and storytelling patterns. Defined [[structured handoffs|Explicit intermediate outputs passed between agents, so the next stage receives the information it needs.]], review checkpoints, targeted rework, and retry limits. Iterated on context gaps and inconsistent outputs across workflow stages.

bullets.label: Runtime context optimization
bullets.body: Separated information needed for later steps from compressible conversation history and tool-call detail. Designed a [[Subagent|A helper agent assigned a focused task; here, extracting useful information from conversation history.]] to summarize history, reducing long-task [[token usage by 5%|Reduction in total token usage for the long tasks evaluated after context optimization.]].

bullets.label: New model adaptation & testing
bullets.body: Adapted Skill interfaces and model routing for Wan 3.0 and Qwen Image 3.0, separating reusable workflows from model-specific calls. During Wan 3.0 testing, coordinated [[30 comparative test cases|Side-by-side generation cases reviewed with creators during the model’s internal testing.]] with creators and documented strengths and priority issues. Used off-peak scheduling and task prioritization during generation bottlenecks; the wider creator rollout produced [[1,200+ pieces of content published|Total content published by participating creators across platforms during the coordinated rollout.]].

stages: Manual reviews varied in criteria and took time. Different Skills also needed different test tasks: one generic instruction could not represent every creative use case.

Tailor instructions and criteria to the Skill, then fix model and tool conditions within each comparison. Review both individual outputs and the completed task; inspect tool-call traces when results fall short.
An internal platform covers 100+ Skills and their versions. Separately, the creation workflow supports 50+ reusable Skills, with guidance and submission standards for external authors.

projects.title: Qwen Create: overseas product exploration
projects.subtitle: Market research, marketing evaluation & growth feature selection
projects.intro: Connected what the agent could produce with overseas search demand to identify useful entry points for an early-stage creative product.

bullets.label: Market research & entry strategy
bullets.body: Compared existing [[organic traffic|Visits from unpaid search results.]], regional purchasing power, and acquisition costs across candidate markets. Helped identify North America as the initial market.

bullets.label: Overseas marketing evaluation
bullets.body: Participated in agent evaluation for North American and Latin American commerce and advertising scenarios. Authored the analysis across intent understanding, marketing scripts, visuals, and editing, identifying suitable use cases, capability limits, and improvement priorities.

bullets.label: SEO research & growth feature selection
bullets.body: Used search demand and conversion potential to prioritize background removal and AI face swap. Found that some features popular in China, such as old-photo restoration and people removal, had limited North American search demand and were more suitable for display-ad creative. Worked with product and growth teams on feature development and campaign direction; the beta recorded [[18% weekly user growth|Weekly growth in the beta user base during the product and growth teams’ rollout.]].

stages: A feature that attracts users in China may not have comparable search demand in North America. Product capability alone does not establish an acquisition opportunity.

Combine marketing-video evaluation with regional traffic, search demand, and conversion potential. Distinguish features people actively search for from features that work better as advertising creative.
Prioritized background removal and AI face swap, informing feature development and campaign direction. During the teams’ rollout, the beta recorded 18% weekly user growth.

experience.role: Brand & Creator Product Intern · Commercial Product Strategy
experience.intro: Helped brands find suitable creators, made collaboration rules more flexible, and connected creators with commercial opportunities.

bullets.label: Creator tagging & search analysis
bullets.body: Contributed to creator-tag reviews, including [[periodic and time-sensitive labels|Labels capture temporary or recurring creator contexts, such as pregnancy-related content or exam seasons.]]. Analyzed search results and collaboration cases to identify matching gaps, reviewed failure cases, and tracked A/B experiments. Search CTR was [[21% versus 18%|Search-result click-through rate: 21% in the experiment group and 18% in the control group.]]; post-search order conversion was [[4.4% versus 4.0%|Post-search order conversion: 4.4% in the experiment group and 4.0% in the control group.]].

bullets.label: Collaboration product improvements
bullets.body: Analyzed client budgets, transaction limits, and the existing collaboration flow. Tested rule boundaries and risks through phased changes before helping productize negotiated minimum prices, larger collaboration capacity, custom timing, and targeted creator invitations. Supported requests worth [[RMB 3 million+|Value of client demand supported by the collaboration-product changes.]]; the number of collaborating creators grew [[135%|Reported growth in collaborating creators following the feature changes.]].

bullets.label: Creator opportunities & campaigns
bullets.body: Addressed demand not yet covered by platform features through creator supply and opportunity matching, including 618 Spark Gala and home-renovation creator recruitment. Brand collaboration orders grew [[25% month over month|Reported month-over-month growth in brand collaboration orders during the campaign.]]. Recommended creators represented [[2% of the pool|Share of the overall creator pool represented by recommended creators.]] and contributed [[11% of order value|Share of order value associated with the recommended creators.]], helping [[400+ creators|More than 400 creators received their first commercial order through these activities.]] receive their first brand deal.

experience.intro: Supported Changi Airport and Pepsi through digital proposals, audience strategies, and hands-on marketing content production.

bullets.label: Digital product proposals
bullets.body: Designed digital features and conducted social media analysis for Changi Airport’s China proposal. Based on Chinese users’ mobile-platform habits and overseas shopping behavior, proposed platform-based touchpoints in place of website-led traffic. Mapped platform roles and touchpoint improvements; the recommendations were adopted by the project strategist.

bullets.label: Marketing content & creator campaigns
bullets.body: Developed creator communication strategies and filmed and edited content with leading and local lifestyle creators. Published videos generated [[1M+ impressions|More than one million cumulative impressions on Douyin across the published campaign videos.]] and [[150K+ interactions|More than 150,000 cumulative interactions on Douyin across the campaign videos.]]. Audience-selection and video-content approaches were reused in subsequent brand proposals.

creatorAssistant.title: Creator Research & Writing Assistant
creatorAssistant.label: Independent project · Built with LangGraph
creatorAssistant.body: Built a [[LangGraph|A framework used to organize stateful agent workflows and communication between steps.]] multi-agent system for smaller creators with a few successful posts but no repeatable approach. Uses past posts and reader feedback to diagnose effective topics, content structures, and audiences. Derives audience profiles from follower behavior, then has agents simulate responses and discuss candidate content for iterative feedback and co-creation. An initial trial across [[3 accounts and 20+ posts|Initial application across three creator accounts and more than 20 posts.]] saw [[approximately 18% higher average readership|Observed change in average readership during the initial trial; other factors may also affect post performance.]].

stages: Creators can have a few successful posts without knowing which topics, structures, or audience needs to build on next.

Use the account’s own history and reader feedback for diagnosis. Coordinate agents with LangGraph to simulate audience responses and discuss drafts; simulated feedback provides additional perspectives for the creator to review.
Applied initially across 3 accounts and 20+ posts, with approximately 18% higher average readership reported. This initial trial helped inform further iteration.

chinaOpen.title: China Open
chinaOpen.label: Overseas social media operations
chinaOpen.body: Communicated with players and international media teams in English, including interviews with Zheng Qinwen and Jannik Sinner. Handled planning, interviews, editing, and publication of [[60+ social posts|More than 60 pieces of social content produced during China Open coverage.]] across Instagram, X, Weibo, WeChat Channels, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin. Received the news-center operations team’s Gold Award ([[top 5%|Reported award standing within the news-center operations team.]]).

bullets.label: Beijing Cultural and Creative Design Competition
bullets.body: First Prize. Used [[Stable Diffusion|An image-generation model used here to create design assets.]] to generate creative design assets, with [[ControlNet|A Stable Diffusion tool that guides image generation with structural inputs such as edges or pose.]] for finer control of the results.

bullets.label: Additional awards
bullets.body: National Excellence Award in the Beijing University Student Advertising Art Competition; municipal First Prize in the Challenge Cup’s social-governance research track.

summary.title: Personal publishing
summary.body: Write about overseas study and personal choices on Xiaohongshu @QSheep: [[1.5K|Approximately 1,500 followers on the personal Xiaohongshu account.]] followers, [[7K+|More than 7,000 likes and saves across posts on the personal account.]] likes and saves, and [[1.4K|Approximately 1,400 likes on the account’s most-liked post.]] likes on the top post.

summary.title: Business & creator workflows
summary.body: Experience across Qwen’s creator supply, Pugongying’s brand collaboration, and client work at Publicis informs how I approach business requirements and creator needs. I also use AI to redesign my own research, writing, and development workflows.

summary.title: Cross-cultural perspective
summary.body: Combine anthropology and communication studies with overseas living, English-language content work, and international growth research to explore how user needs differ across contexts.

summary.title: Directing, writing & content creation
summary.body: Directed 《禁忌话题》, one of five selected films in Apple’s China creative camp, and won Best Original Story in the Apple × Shanghai Theatre Academy student short-film competition. Featured on Apple’s official Douyin and WeChat accounts and interviewed by Phoenix and other media; [[100K+ views|More than 100,000 total views across platforms.]]. Led CUC’s Baiyang Drama Club and contributed to a production that won Best Communication at the Prism Theatre Festival.

sheepGuide.title: Qwen · Agents & evaluation
notes: Each creative Skill needs a test that reflects what it is meant to do. This project connects those tests with an automated evaluation platform.

Qishan compared Skill versions under fixed model and tool conditions, evaluated individual steps and complete tasks, and traced failures through tool calls. She also worked on structured handoffs, author guidance, and new-model testing.
The evaluation platform covers 100+ Skills and versions; creation work supports 50+ reusable Skills. Context optimization reduced long-task token usage by 5%.

sheepGuide.title: Qwen · Overseas exploration
notes: What can the agent do well, and what are overseas users actually searching for? Those two questions guide this work.
Qishan participated in North American and Latin American marketing evaluations and wrote the analysis. Search research helped separate active search demand from display-ad opportunities.
Background removal and AI face swap became acquisition priorities. During the teams’ rollout, the beta recorded 18% weekly user growth.

sheepGuide.title: Xiaohongshu · Brand & creator products
notes: This work helps brands find suitable creators and makes commercial collaboration easier.
Qishan contributed to creator labels, matching-gap analysis, and experiment tracking. Search CTR was 21% versus 18%; order conversion was 4.4% versus 4.0%, comparing experiment and control groups.
The work also covered flexible collaboration features and creator campaigns. Campaign orders grew 25% month over month, and 400+ creators received their first brand deal.

sheepGuide.title: Publicis · Client campaigns
notes: Audience understanding becomes practical here: digital touchpoints, creator selection, and the content itself.
For Changi Airport, mobile-platform habits and overseas shopping behavior informed a proposal for platform-based digital touchpoints.
Marketing work also included on-site filming and editing. Published campaign videos reached 1M+ impressions and 150K+ interactions on Douyin; the brand reused the audience and content approaches.

sheepGuide.title: Personal · Creator assistant
notes: How can a creator turn a few successful posts into a repeatable approach? This independent project starts from the account’s own history.

Built with LangGraph, it combines account diagnosis, audience profiles, and agent discussion to support topics and drafts. The agents simulate audience reactions to give the creator more perspectives on a draft.
The initial trial covered 3 accounts and 20+ posts, with approximately 18% higher average readership reported.

sheepGuide.title: China Open · Content operations
notes: Creating content at a live international sporting event means coordinating quickly across people and platforms.
Qishan communicated with players and media teams in English, including interviews with Zheng Qinwen and Jannik Sinner, and handled planning, editing, and publishing.
She produced 60+ social posts across international and Chinese platforms and received the news-center operations team’s Gold Award, in the top 5%.

sheepGuide.title: Creative competitions
notes: These projects add a hands-on visual and creative side to the product work.
The cultural-design project used Stable Diffusion for visual assets and ControlNet to guide generation.
It received First Prize in the Beijing Cultural and Creative Design Competition. Additional advertising and social-governance research awards appear alongside it.
